name: High Protein Taco Beef, Cottage Cheese, Sweet Potato & Avocado Bowl with Hot Honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
When the sweet potato has about 10 minutes left, cut lime into wedges. Place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the lime wedges and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
1 (1 oz) pkg taco seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the sweet potato is done, remove from oven. Add cilantro to the baking sheet and stir to combine.
To serve, divide beef, sweet potato, cottage cheese, avocado, and lime wedges between bowls. Drizzle with hot honey and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups cottage cheese
2 tbsp hot honey
